answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with a tended reputation garden: every agent stakes tokens that unlock slowly, and standing grows only through verified work over time. Endorsements are weighted by the endorser's own stake and history, so fresh identities that merely echo one another form a detectable loop — many voices, one wallet behind them. Genuine standing reaches a flat mesa, then decays without continued honest service, so an attacker must keep paying real costs — stake, time, useful work — to hold many identities, while one honest agent pays almost nothing.
